issues.reason: Core patterns: "a stated restriction, hedge or qualifier is never silently dropped — omitting it widens the claim"; with `dim` gone the pattern binds any lantern group of the Hollows, so the query asks something broader than the question.

new_gaps: A descriptive modifier on a DEFINITE PLURAL has no queryable carrier: the statement doctrine distributes it to the members as `(Implication (PartOf $x <group>) (Member $x dim))` and bars `(Member <group> dim)` on the group symbol, so a question about "the dim lanterns" can only reach it through `(PartOf $m $l) (Member $m dim)`, which stays dormant until some member is individuated — the instruction set licenses no group-level restriction atom for a query to bind.
defect_summary: The query must carry "dim", but the only forms the instruction set reaches are the member conjuncts `(PartOf $m $l) (Member $m dim)` (dormant until a member is individuated) or a fused `dim_lantern` kind, which Compound concepts bars as incidental description — so no clean compliant form is licensed and the missing carrier is filed as a gap.
notes: The two decomposition conjuncts `(Inheritance nightmoth moth)` / `(Inheritance sky_cat_hunt hunt)` are redundant rather than wrong — a statement parse of those compounds emits them — though as query conjuncts they can only drop answers. Everything else follows the instruction set: `Goal` for "flee to", `During` for "during", the participial modifier `surviving` as an adjective, `Name`-bound Hollows, and `(ReasonFor $r $e)` on the focus event.
